tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: Search the VoiceAssistants directory of local US businesses by what the person needs (a trade such as "plumber", a service such as "drain cleaning", or a business name) and where (city and two-letter state). Optional filters: open right now, available today, or a maximum starting price in US dollars

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get the facts on file for one business in the VoiceAssistants directory: what it is, where, phone, hours, and — for a premium listing — services with supplied prices, service area, credentials and live availability. Every fact comes from the business; `source` and `last_verified` say where and when.

tools.name: get_hours
tools.description: Answer "is it open now?", "when does it close?" and "is it open on Thanksgiving?" for one business in the VoiceAssistants directory. findings.detail: Description of "get_business" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_callback" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
